SQL: SELECT "Route Code", COUNT(*) AS scheduled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN "Cancelled Flag" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations FROM wisdomai."Flight — Enriched View" WHERE "Flight Date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "Flight Date" < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY "Route Code" ORDER BY "Route Code"
